title: Ghostline
summary: Pay-per-call channels for AI agents using cumulative off-chain vouchers and one settlement. On November 12, Veil’s Esmeralda explorer displayed GhostlineChannel template 21a4b999…3131ac05, three functions and publication epoch 12938. The current source evidence identifies its November 7 publication with template library 0.38. In the November 9 original-post edit, the creator reports a 51 µT deposit, five paid calls, an overspend rejection and one settlement; those counts are attributed service-ledger evidence, not independent chain proof. The README explicitly limits current payments to Esmeralda testnet; mainnet remains a future goal. Optional browser live mode requires Sapient 0.7.1 or later and a custodial relay that holds the test deposit through settlement or refund. Fees, timing, channel metadata and requests remain observable; the batch prototype is not coordinator-private. The v0.4.0 CLI requires Linux x86-64 with glibc. The new November 12 recording is a README walkthrough. The November 4 walletless simulation recording, its observed five calls and rejection, and earlier transaction URLs remain in maintenance history. No wallet action, deposit, CLI execution or active application review was performed for this source refresh. MIT source.
